meta.title: PostgreSQL
meta.tagline: The most advanced open-source relational database.
meta.description: PostgreSQL is the world's most advanced open-source relational database. It offers ACID compliance, extensibility, rich data types (JSONB, arrays, hstore), powerful indexing and proven reliability for production workloads.
